_note: Publishing cadence set by the operator. Weekday numbers are Python's: Monday=0 .. Sunday=6. Reminder times are local to whatever machine runs the scheduled task; this repo does not install the task, it prints the entry for you to install.

stickman._brand_note: Stickman longform stays unschedulable until channels/stickman/brand.json marks every brand asset done. The canon calls this channel's identity blocked, so the schedule respects that rather than routing around it.

lilweid._note: The operator has not set a Lilweid longform cadence. Slots are assigned by hand with `scheduler assign --date`; nothing is invented here.

shorts._note: One short per day per queued platform, mapped in channels/<channel>/publish-plan.csv.

upload._link_note: os.link() makes a real NTFS hardlink on Windows and a POSIX hardlink elsewhere. Source and destination must sit on the same volume; a cross-volume attempt fails loudly rather than silently copying.
